title: Add assumption-guarantee capsule substitution

scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python v1 deterministic, CID-bound capsule substitution under explicit producer, schema, compiler, binding-projection, index, block, confidence, and invalidation assumptions
scope.implementation_delta: The exact current-head datasets source forest already supplies the sole canonical Python-v1 assumption-guarantee substitution authority: CapsuleFreshness@1, assessed by assess_capsule_freshness and consumed through is_safe_substitute/requires_raw_source. This receipt selects and binds that authority. No proof_context wrapper, competing substitute evaluator, alternate identity, source-map authority, or M2/M3 mutation was introduced.

In the authoritative sealed Python 3.12 environment pytest aborts before collection because its explicitly configured anyio pytest plugin is unavailable; no sealed passing result is claimed.

assumptions: The candidate is a closed SemanticCapsule whose claimed capsule CID recomputes from its canonical identity payload.

The current state is a verified SemanticStateView with a closed SemanticStateRoot, matching capsule schema/compiler version, producer identity, relevant binding projection, and retrievable canonical capsule index/block.
Applicable invalidation obligations are provided and their reason/remediation classes are evaluated fail-closed.
guarantees: A fresh exact capsule receives exact_substitute only when its index and canonical stored block reverify, producer and binding facts agree, and no blocking obligation applies.
A fresh conservative capsule may receive conservative_substitute_with_caveats only with visible caveats; is_safe_substitute preserves those caveats.

Heuristic/opaque confidence, stale or unknown state, missing/corrupt/mismatched index or block, producer/schema/compiler/binding mismatch, and raw-source/full-fallback obligations yield raw_source_required or an input-validation failure; they cannot be admitted as exact substitutes.

determinism_and_closure: CapsuleFreshness canonicalizes applicable obligation IDs and caveats as unique sorted tuples, and derives its assessment CID from its closed DAG-JSON identity payload.
The assessor re-verifies both the candidate capsule CID and the stored index/capsule blocks before admitting substitution.
AdmissionDecision is a closed three-value vocabulary: exact_substitute, conservative_substitute_with_caveats, and raw_source_required.
selected_existing_authority.minimum_delta_reason: Current-head source already supplies the exact versioned Python-v1 substitution authority and direct positive/negative coverage. Reimplementation under proof_context would duplicate canonical authority and violates this task's receipt-only declared output boundary.

limitations: This task is receipt-only: it selects the existing current-head canonical substitution authority and does not mutate proof_context or create a second evaluator.

The guarantee is bounded to the assessed static semantic-state facts. It does not establish whole-CPython runtime semantics, dynamic import/reflection/native behavior, generated-code correctness, or a PCSM source-link artifact.

Substitution is valid only under the bound tree, source digests, schemas, compiler version, CID profile, verified state/index/block, producer/binding projection, confidence, and invalidation inputs; any change invalidates this receipt.
The authoritative sealed suite remains unavailable because anyio is absent, so this receipt cannot promote completion despite provider-side passing results.
The receipt's own canonical storage CID is unavailable because minting a self-describing CID would change its bytes.
